limits: The captures demonstrate synthetic Flutter widget rendering at 1280x900 (English/German) and 390x844 (Arabic), not installed native macOS/Windows/mobile packaging or real-account interoperability.
Visual review is tied to these static fixture states; native restore correctness and cancellation/integrity behavior are assessed separately by the accepted VM tests.
method: All 12 accepted-run PNGs were individually displayed and visually inspected by the independent reviewer. Their SHA-256 identities below bind this observation to the final Flutter fixture captures, whose published copies match byte-for-byte.
observations: English and German restore previews show the current 2026-11-19 00:00:00 UTC timestamp, source profile, message/byte/provenance counts, restore explanation, attachment-text option and action buttons.
The 390 px Arabic restore preview preserves numeric timestamp order; UTC wraps onto the following line. Arabic headings, copy and controls follow the RTL layout.
Restore result captures in all three languages show 3 saved, 2 already archived, 0 failed, 5 planned, 4 source entries added, 1135 verified bytes and 0 indexing warnings.
Desktop English and narrow Arabic portability, export confirmation and export report captures show legible controls and counts. The long export destination wraps within the narrow Arabic report.
No overflow diagnostic stripes or missing primary action buttons were observed in these captures. Result fixtures intentionally scroll the archive controls to make their report visible.
product_relationship: The fixture renders the real StudioMailArchiveDialog and captures its RenderRepaintBoundary, with injected synthetic store/file services and project fonts. It is included among the passing final mail tests.
